During the

Allocation Percentage
rule exists for the specific channel setup:
Standard Mode (No Value):
If no percentage is set, the system bypasses the calculation mode and syncs 100% of the available inventory directly.
Calculation Mode (Value Exists):
If a percentage is defined, the system calculates the final quantity using the following formula:
Final Sync Quantity
= Floor (Available Quantity * (Allocation Percentage / 100))
Rounding Rule:
Results always use a
Floor
strategy, meaning they round down to the nearest whole number to prevent overselling (e.g., a result of 3.9 becomes 3).
